title: Tape change and new session, January 23, 1973
summary: Hinton turns the tape for a fresh subject and resumes two days after the last session.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Jo, I think I'll just turn this tape right here rather than go into a new subject, so we can start fresh on Tape 7 with a new subject. Hang on.

Hey, Jo, we're still talking about this stuff. This is, what, January 23rd now, 1973, and we're still talking about the different things that went on and the last time we stopped a couple of days ago we got to 'Boogie-Woogie' and Pinetop stuff and 'How Long Blues'. You told me Freddie Green was singing on one of those records.
